      3. Build your CIA

      MobiPEG downloads the player directly from VidInjector when you choose this option. These third-party files have unclear licensing; use them only if you have permission. Real 3DS compatibility is not yet verified. You can also choose your own player in Advanced settings.

      Add your movies and choose a player to get started.

      Advanced settings

      An ID is generated automatically. MobiPEG avoids IDs generated earlier in this browser, but cannot check which titles are installed on your 3DS. You can enter your own ID.

      A selected decrypted player CIA takes priority over VidInjector. Collection players support up to 27 episodes; a single-movie player supports one.

      Each part uses the next available title ID, starting with yours. Allow multiple downloads when prompted.

      Browser storage is temporary and can be cleared by your device. Keep downloaded copies.

      Save or open a project

      Reopening a project restores your movie order and settings. Select its original video and artwork files too.

      Projects contain your settings, not the movie files. The JSON also works with the desktop builder.

      Edit artwork

      Drag the image to reposition it. The saved crop will be used in your CIA.
